title: Keep it to Yourself
lyrics_plain:
(Intro)
Baby, do me a favor,
keep our business to yourself.
Please, darlin', do me a favor,
keep our business to yourself.
I don't want you to tell nobody in your family,
and don't mention it to nobody else.
(Break)
Don't tell your mother,
don't tell your father,
don't tell your sister,
don't mention it to your brother.
Please, darlin', keep our business to yourself.
Don't you tell nobody
and don't mention it to nobody else.
(Break)
You have a husband,
I have a wife.
If you start to talk of that,
you'll mess up our life.
Please, please, baby,
keep our business to yourself.
Don't you tell nobody,
don't mention it to nobody else.
Goodbye, darlin'.
